cases.given: Qualified stable read view, same authorized object, complete hashes match independently supplied expected digest, one selected stream, qualified full exact boundary evidence and range fit.
cases.expected: bound_for_read_view; duration/range compatible; content remains not_reviewed
cases.limit: Requires separately accepted and directly tested OS/tool profile; this is a planned synthetic case, not qualification.

cases.given: Selection grant missing, forged or expired; loaded sidecar carries a former selected_file_ref.
cases.expected: rejected / selection_required; no file resolution or process launch
cases.limit: A serialized report never grants capability.

cases.given: Symlink/reparse component, parent traversal, network/UNC share, device, FIFO, mount crossing or unqualified multi-link alias.
cases.limit: Do not follow to inspect the out-of-scope target.

cases.given: File missing or unreadable after explicit authorized selection.
cases.expected: file_access unreadable; binding rejected or unknown; no success
cases.limit: Public error contains no local path.

cases.given: Same asset_id/revision selected with changed bytes.
cases.expected: byte_identity mismatch / fingerprint_mismatch; reject previous-binding reuse
cases.limit: Preserve original evidence; no automatic catalog revision.

cases.given: Rename replacement between first hash and probe.
cases.expected: file_changed or unknown; pathname reopen is forbidden
cases.limit: Probe must use selected read view, not a late pathname lookup.

cases.given: Concurrent write-and-restore (ABA) with equal before/after SHA and stat.
cases.limit: Hash equality alone cannot pass this case.

cases.given: Qualified stability lease is lost; an old writable mapping or handle makes exclusivity unprovable.
cases.limit: Require positive OS-profile proof, not advisory locks.

cases.given: Tool tries a relative external file, URL or other protocol.
cases.expected: probe failed / scope_rejected; no file/network side read
cases.limit: Protocol flags plus tested OS sandbox; no fallback download.

cases.given: Tool/hash exceeds byte/time/output/stream/packet budget, malformed/truncated JSON or incomplete reads.
cases.expected: unknown / budget_exceeded or probe_failed; retain partial evidence privately
cases.limit: No partial-output success or auto-retry; supervise process-tree quiescence.

cases.given: More than one eligible video stream and no explicit selected stream; attached image is stream 0.
cases.expected: metadata unknown / stream_ambiguous; no implicit first-stream selection
cases.limit: Explicit stream selector is part of the binding.

cases.given: VFR or unknown cadence with only nominal/average fps; request supplied frame indices.
cases.expected: timing unknown / timing_unknown; frame mapping unsupported
cases.limit: No inference of PTS from metadata fps.

cases.given: Only header duration exists, packet scan partial, PTS missing/discontinuous or container/stream disagree.
cases.limit: A complete normalized observed interval needs a qualified basis.

cases.given: Qualified observed interval is shorter than declared duration, or selected OUT lies outside it.
cases.expected: duration incompatible and/or range incompatible; no clamping
cases.limit: Existing V1 may independently accept declarations; sidecar must preserve contradiction.

cases.given: No authorized expected fingerprint exists for this asset revision.
cases.expected: byte_identity not_verified; new observed baseline only; binding not_verified
cases.limit: Never substitute the new observed hash as expected.

cases.given: All technical checks pass but images depict a different narrative beat.
cases.expected: content not_reviewed or rejected after actual author review

cases.given: Sidecar with unknown version/field/duplicate key or integer/rational overflow.
cases.limit: Schema shape checks do not replace strict raw JSON and semantic validation.

cases.given: Same selection reused after coverage bytes, asset revision, source range, tool/profile or expected evidence changes.
cases.limit: Do not overwrite prior evidence or current result with a stale response.
